decisions.reason: The encrypted second channel builds directly on the firm's core cryptography and authentication know-how, so it can interpret early feedback and improve the product through its own R&D, and it fits the move toward binding mobile communication.
Mobile PDF signing is close to the established offer and supports the online contract signing direction, though it is a narrower feature that could later be folded into the broader suite.
The multi-layer end-to-end architecture is the conceptual backbone of the firm's integrated offering and draws most directly on its deep security knowledge.

The email-to-app delivery robot uses the firm's secure messaging competence, but its niche use case and the firm's limited ability to read market signals for it make it more likely to be reworked or dropped.
The QR-based hardware token builds on the firm's hardware and authentication experience, but app-based authentication is displacing hardware tokens, which raises the risk of withdrawal.
The payment network compliance suite relies on cryptography know-how and regulatory demand such as PSD2, but its compliance-specific scope may lead to repackaging.
